text: We’re starting the push to free the south. People on the shore in Henichesk can hear a low rumble. Those are strategic bombers, Bondarenko. This will be your first encounter with them.
The big ones, carrying the new missiles?
Yes. Their missiles are faster and hit harder than any you’ve seen. If there’s no time for the dragon to shoot one down, change altitude.
That’s our aircraft making a scheduled turn. The camera has also caught a dragon in the left corner. Could we crop that corner, please? Yes, right on schedule.
They can keep the whole picture. I’ll settle for those planes staying well clear of Henichesk.
